notes_for_editor: Only one list line supports this record, so the story is about 65 words, below the 120-word floor. It was not padded. Not on the NHLR Georgia list or the FFLOS Georgia listing checked. The Forest Lookouts Georgia page lists a different Jackson County tower, Arcade, not this one. Search returned a Jackson County 'Fire Tower' treehouse rental (Vrbo, Airbnb and glamping listings); it is a modern treehouse, not a lookout, and should not be linked to this record.
